# Rechvix

> Self-hosted billing, inventory, double-entry accounting and CRM by NodeDR, with multiple companies, interface languages, invoice currencies and documented country tax scope. Scoped REST API, signed webhooks and a read-only MCP server (sales, stock, receivables, GST). Requires running your own instance. Not a certified tax filing service.
